skills.plan_reason: Generated frames must remain technically clean enough to judge the pendulum apparatus, protractor markings, rest marker, string, bob, and fixed measurement setup.
The rollout should show present, temporally smooth pendulum motion after release from the marked angle, without jitter, teleporting, or discontinuous bob/string movement.

causal_checks: After release, gravity causes the bob to accelerate toward the lowest point.
The bob speed increases while descending and decreases while ascending.
The string constrains the bob to a circular arc centered at the fixed pivot.
At each extreme angle, the bob momentarily slows or stops before reversing direction.
Without a push, the first swing amplitude is set by the initial marked release angle, not by an added impulse.
Any damping causes successive peak angles to shrink gradually rather than grow.
The pivot and frame remain stationary while only the bob and string angle move.
controlled_variables: Camera position, framing, focus, and perspective remain fixed.
Support frame, baseboard, protractor, level-3 label, marked angle indicator, and all apparatus anchors remain fixed.
String length and pivot point remain constant.
Bob mass, shape, and appearance remain constant.
Release is passive with no visible shove, throw, or added horizontal impulse.
No external contact occurs after release.
expected_spec.expected_response: The bob begins from the marked medium level-3 angular displacement and swings downward under gravity along a circular arc about the fixed pivot. It passes through the lowest point with maximum speed, rises to the opposite side to a similar but slightly reduced height if damping is present, then reverses and continues oscillating. The string remains taut and straight, the pivot stays fixed, and the oscillation plane remains aligned with the measurement setup.
failure_modes: Bob launches with an obvious push or non-passive impulse.
Bob moves in a straight line instead of a pendulum arc.
Pivot, frame, protractor, baseboard, or camera shifts during the rollout.
String stretches, detaches, goes slack, or changes length without cause.
Bob starts from the wrong angle or from rest at the bottom.
Oscillation amplitude grows without external energy input.
Bob teleports, changes size, changes material, or disappears.
Motion occurs out of the measurement plane so the angle cannot be judged.
The apparatus anchors or marked level indicator are modified during motion.
expected_spec.intervention: Set pendulum_release to medium level 3 and release the bob from the marked angle with no push.
expected_spec.target_system: A simple pendulum apparatus: a black spherical bob suspended by a fixed string from a stationary overhead support, viewed by a fixed measurement camera with a protractor scale and level marker on the baseboard.
